decision: Blocked all production mutation until coherent PostgreSQL/SQLite/config backups restored successfully in isolation.
evidence: Dispatcharr restore counts matched 55339 streams, 907 groups, 0 channels, 1 user; SQLite integrity passed; measured restore 3 seconds.
alternativesRejected: File copies without WAL coherence; untested backup artifacts.
safetyRollback: Protected timestamped backup root and paired image/database rollback checkpoint.

decision: Used explicit /config data persistence, trusted forwarded host/proto variables, immutable Otpravkarr image, and paused automatic updates.
evidence: Image inspection, restart persistence, health, migration count, and digest checks.
alternativesRejected: Nightly/latest deployment; implicit database location; secret rotation.
safetyRollback: Prior digest and pre-migration database retained as a pair.

decision: Exposed only query-based XC/XMLTV endpoints and credential-free logo cache; denied public direct live path.
evidence: Route matrix passed for authorized, missing, bad, and revoked credentials; four materially different logging suppression attempts still emitted credential-bearing live paths.
alternativesRejected: Broad public Dispatcharr outputs; credential paths in logs; scope expansion to an unapproved playback proxy.
safetyRollback: Validated and backed-up Caddy block; public live default-denied.
validation: partial: public metadata/guide pass, public playback blocked

decision: Implemented explicit fixed, core_bundles, and approved_selection policies with stable bundles and retained intent.
evidence: Migration tests, resolver tests, live policy-mode exercise, idempotent reconciliation, and orphan/zero-selection coverage.
alternativesRejected: Implicit minimal overlay; Dispatcharr fork; plugin orchestration.
safetyRollback: Immutable migration 003 and paired pre-migration database/image rollback.

decision: Kept zero effective selection on the shared empty profile and all non-owner subscribers at Dispatcharr level 1.
evidence: Live zero-selection produced zero groups, one profile, and zero channels; fixed/core/approved modes retained level 1.
alternativesRejected: Empty channel_profiles array; admin-level subscriber; implicit all-groups fallback.
safetyRollback: Reconcile block and subscriber-disable trigger on invariant violation.

decision: Kept plugin integration read-only and rendered credential QR locally only after explicit authenticated action.
evidence: ECM mutation call removed, mutator deleted, regression tests cover manual/scheduled reconcile, QR/copy component tests pass.
alternativesRejected: Otpravkarr plugin settings/run/enable mutations; third-party or persistent QR generation.
safetyRollback: No remote plugin mutation surface; masked credentials by default.

decision: Created only six groups supported by actual catalog evidence and a 25-channel Danish-first curated lineup.
evidence: Live catalog inspection, recognizable broadcaster ordering, bounded staging, profile-scoped negative tests.
alternativesRejected: Empty taxonomy groups; fake header channels; VOD/radio/adult/movie content.
safetyRollback: Dispatcharr backup and staged profile reconciliation after creation.

decision: Disabled the failing custom M3U source rather than deleting it.
evidence: Historical and live health showed STRNG8K healthy and custom failing.
alternativesRejected: Hard deletion without proof of obsolescence; using unhealthy source.

decision: Assigned one owner per action/field transition and serialized plugin order.
evidence: Installed manifests/settings/actions for all seven plugins, bounded previews and health/EPG reports.
alternativesRejected: Scheduled overlapping writers; Otpravkarr orchestration; recurring deletion.

decision: Ranked and attached streams using measured probes at concurrency two, retaining alternates.
evidence: 59 attached streams passed IPTV Checker; bounded ffprobe measurements; controlled primary loss used an alternate.
safetyRollback: Primary restored after bounded failure test; stop/halve trigger above 20 percent failures.

decision: Used exact country-scoped STRNG8K EPG for 24 channels and left Motorvision unmatched.
evidence: 24 mapped channels all had program data after refresh; no trustworthy Motorvision match.
alternativesRejected: All-source Janitor search; low-confidence application; overwriting healthy EPG with EPGeditARR.
safetyRollback: Dry-run/source allowlist and provider EPG checkpoint.
validation: passed with one intentional unmatched channel

decision: Did not create event groups or synthetic events because the live catalog has no trustworthy event content.
evidence: Catalog and plugin scope inspection found no supported scheduled/unscheduled event channels.
alternativesRejected: Fake groups; fake headers; claiming unobserved fail-open behavior.
safetyRollback: ECM schedule and refresh hook remain disabled.

decision: Left all recurring plugin schedules disabled.
evidence: Manual bounded operations passed, but two stable runs across provider churn were not available in the execution window.
alternativesRejected: Enabling schedules without the stated stability gate.
safetyRollback: No recurring mutation or deletion; operator sequence documented.

decision: Used native Dispatcharr profile-scoped xmltv.php and did not add an Otpravkarr XMLTV proxy.
evidence: Authorized guide count matched the profile, unauthorized/revoked credentials were denied, and no cross-profile guide leakage appeared.
safetyRollback: Existing native route and Caddy matcher only.

decision: Fixed the fresh-setup E2E seed to store its setup claim proof using production-compatible encryption.
evidence: The required setup-wizard-fresh project collected and passed one real browser test.
alternativesRejected: Skipping the project; storing sensitive setup proof as plaintext; accepting zero tests.
safetyRollback: Test-only seed and isolated temporary database.

decision: Removed cached-profile trust and fail-open group-ID compatibility at every subscription boundary after final review.
evidence: Every empty/group profile is reconciled against remote state before assignment; malformed approval state offers zero groups; direct zero, negative, fractional, unsafe, NaN, and infinite IDs fail before remote lookup/discovery/mutation; helper tests prove contaminated/deleted/empty profile repair; stale cache IDs are ignored; 1304 unit tests and both E2E gates passed.
alternativesRejected: TTL cache leakage window; local profile ID as proof of remote membership; tolerant salvage of malformed arrays; accepting contaminated direct IDs; null meaning offer all.
safetyRollback: Fresh coherent SQLite/Compose backup, immutable review-fix image, prior deployed digests retained.
